packages.entry_gate: Read-only inventory and current remote heads retained.

packages.entry_gate: The original 79 requirement IDs are retained.
packages.exit_gate: Every requirement has one delivery package; CI rejects drift and invalid dependencies; each increment has exact source and evidence.
packages.title: Make delivery and evidence mechanically checkable

packages.entry_gate: Current profile and legacy fixtures are pinned.
packages.exit_gate: Identity, revision, references, authoritative records and context boundaries pass shared positive and negative cases.
packages.title: Finish the small common contract

packages.entry_gate: Captured folder format, digest rules and export limits are explicit.
packages.exit_gate: Python, TypeScript, Hub and native hosts reopen transferred packs after originals are removed; attachment loss, unsafe paths and unsupported content are handled explicitly.
packages.title: Transfer complete packs and preserve attachments

packages.entry_gate: Original ORF fixtures and byte-preserved capture are available.
packages.exit_gate: Continue, challenge, correct, refresh, redact, supersede and retract retain evidence, disagreement, permission and migration loss receipts.
packages.title: Complete the Research lifecycle

packages.entry_gate: Two installed implementations support the same pinned Research case.
packages.exit_gate: Independent workers exchange, revise and reopen a real investigation offline with source bytes, unknown fields and disagreement intact.
packages.title: Prove independent Research exchange

packages.entry_gate: Small-substrate scenarios expose unresolved semantics.
packages.exit_gate: Person, Receipt, Contract, Project, Decision and System have fixtures and usable views; Research remains first and Workbook remains additional.
packages.title: Complete the six reference cases and context map

packages.entry_gate: Identity and authority boundaries are fixed for this increment.
packages.exit_gate: Ambiguous matches are reversible; cyclic or unavailable references are bounded; stale edits and cross-device conflicts cannot silently lose data.
packages.title: Handle identity, composition and concurrent history

packages.entry_gate: Local publication and creation kits already work.
packages.exit_gate: An unfamiliar author scaffolds, validates, explains and publishes a separate data-only profile with actionable failures and no Foundation repository dependency.
packages.title: Make profile authoring self-service

packages.entry_gate: Publisher trust model and namespace proposal are reviewed for implementation.
packages.exit_gate: Authorized publication, alias and ownership changes, revocation, approved refresh and private sources pass immutable-pin, rollback and offline tests.
packages.title: Authenticate publishing and remote resolution

packages.entry_gate: Canonical catalog and complete-pack contracts are available.
packages.exit_gate: Human, JSON and MCP versions agree; desktop and phone flows create, find, edit and export useful local packs with explicit offline/error states.
packages.title: Finish one Hub discovery and authoring surface

packages.entry_gate: Publisher identity, privacy policy and reporting ownership are defined.
packages.exit_gate: Moderation, reports, appeals and retention work; optional collection has authenticated consent, revocation and anti-abuse proof before activation.
packages.title: Operate moderation and honest adoption signals

packages.entry_gate: Portable formats and package boundaries are pinned.
packages.exit_gate: Clean installed Python, TypeScript and native artifacts pass exact-version compatibility; release artifacts, provenance and supported client instructions are durable.
packages.title: Release supported packages and clients

packages.entry_gate: Dirty Mac work is protected and a clean candidate is built.
packages.exit_gate: Signed installed capture, convert, edit, search, recovery and complete export pass with the existing identity; private-store and Keychain proofs remain private.
packages.title: Accept Primboard as a trustworthy daily product

packages.entry_gate: prim-sim source scope, provenance and reuse authority are resolved.
packages.exit_gate: Clean native build, reconciled integration PRs and real signed open-edit-save/attachments/FDA/XPC acceptance pass on supported Macs.
packages.title: Recover and ship the generic Desktop host

packages.entry_gate: Working public and native candidate journeys are available.
packages.exit_gate: Screen reader, keyboard, phone, localization, low-resource/offline and representative household/organization continuity tasks have retained results.
packages.title: Prove accessibility and representative environments

packages.entry_gate: Artifact lineage and scoped operation contracts exist.
packages.exit_gate: Original bytes, source change/revocation/deletion, hostile recursion, cancellation, quotas and resumability pass local plus authorized remote connector tests.
packages.title: Finish trustworthy local and remote ingestion

packages.entry_gate: Threat boundaries and knowledge-versus-authority semantics are explicit.
packages.exit_gate: Actual runtime enforcement rejects unauthorized, expired, revoked and over-budget work; receipts, idempotency and emergency stop survive restart.
packages.title: Enforce bounded agent operations

packages.entry_gate: Source and data boundaries are inventoried without exporting private material.
packages.exit_gate: Threat-led tests, key recovery, renderer/parser isolation, supply-chain controls and scoped independent security/incident review meet the declared release scope.
packages.title: Close security and private-data failure modes

packages.entry_gate: Per-repository privacy, license and consumer classifications exist.
packages.exit_gate: Every migration retains originals, versioned loss reports and second-reader proof; every remaining repository has an explicit private, tooling or historical disposition.
packages.title: Migrate incubators and prove compatibility

packages.entry_gate: Old clients, provider ownership, costs and rollback artifacts are mapped.
packages.exit_gate: A reviewed production route change passes TLS, quotas, legacy clients, real external MCP host and observed rollback/return with accountable operators.
packages.title: Cut the public Hub over with verified ownership

packages.entry_gate: Login/gateway source is consolidated and the real-account test boundary is authorized.
packages.exit_gate: Real Apple login, cookies, container routing, tenant isolation, expiry, monitoring and production rollback pass; old services retire only after compatibility gates.
packages.title: Prove Browsers and consolidate its live services

packages.entry_gate: Current services and authority boundaries are inventoried.
packages.exit_gate: Named operators, approved costs, supported versions, recovery goals and backup/key-loss/vendor-exit drills are exercised by a replacement maintainer.
packages.title: Make recovery, maintenance and free operation sustainable

packages.entry_gate: Existing charter and reserved human decisions are retained.
packages.exit_gate: Human-approved rights, licensing and standards policies have actual owners; outside contribution, transfer, succession and abandoned-maintainer cases are resolved.
packages.title: Establish actual stewardship and policy ownership

packages.entry_gate: Representative cases and accessible product journeys are usable.
packages.exit_gate: Coverage, Fidelity and Operability preserve unknowns; new user/publisher tasks need no founder help; maintained docs, examples, releases and support paths exist.
packages.title: Deliver useful diagnostics, onboarding and support

packages.entry_gate: Release candidates and scoped review materials are reproducible.
packages.exit_gate: Consented outside feedback changes tracked requirements; all critical gates pass and the weighted readiness assessment retains any explicitly accepted final-five-percent deferrals.
packages.title: Run independent acceptance and close the release

tasks.scope: Reconcile all 79 requirements against exact evidence; distinguish missing implementation from review and real-use gates. Correct summary pages and document the proposed rubric assessment without inventing partial credit.
tasks.tests: All requirements retained; every credited outcome cites evidence; missing gates visible; generated roadmap and program checks pass. A second pass compares the result to actual release/CI references.
tasks.title: Establish the scored release baseline and repair stale summaries

tasks.scope: Extend native storage to retain attachments, receipts, identity and unknown supported files through the current journal; integrate import/edit/export UI and CLI.
tasks.tests: Synthetic pack moves Python/Hub → native → TypeScript after deleting disposable originals; payload digests and intended edits match. Reject traversal, conflicting entries, missing bytes, oversized input and stale edits; crash recovery preserves committed work.
tasks.title: Implement native complete-pack import, edit and export

tasks.estimate: 3–8 active hours, excluding any observed consent wait
tasks.scope: Instrument the previously timed-out private roundtrip in bounded stages on a retained copy. No active-store migration, key replacement or key export. Report an OS consent gate only if observed.
tasks.tests: Existing key authenticates copied payloads; migration, backup and new-destination restore preserve metadata and encrypted bytes. Original/snapshot digests unchanged; sanitized receipt retained. Timeout remains failure, not acceptance.
tasks.title: Diagnose and complete existing-key encrypted snapshot restore

tasks.scope: Map preserved video, recording, column, worker and conversion behavior; integrate declared release features without overwriting dirty source. Prepare signed candidate and rollback checkpoint.
tasks.tests: Mac suite/release checks pass; notarization, fresh extraction and actual installed open/edit/save/restart/export pass; app and CLI retain store identities; permission denial is usable; prior installation can be restored.
tasks.title: Reconcile richer Primboard UI and prove a safe installed upgrade

tasks.scope: Create synthetic documents/image, conflicting assertions, unknown and unavailable sources; implement missing lifecycle behavior in a versioned contract with retained migration semantics.
tasks.tests: Capture retry is idempotent; changed/missing sources are detected; challenge/correction/retraction preserve disagreements and provenance. Schema validity does not establish truth. Existing Research fixtures retain documented meaning.
tasks.title: Build the Research capture, challenge and revision demonstration

tasks.scope: Run the same investigation through installed tools and hosted Hub; record a sanitized demonstration and recruit independent participation only after candidate preparation.
tasks.tests: Original test source removed; second reader sees exact attachments, identity, revisions and unknown fields. Offline continuation and restored-copy recovery pass. Independent worker evidence is separate from same-author implementations.
tasks.title: Prove the complete investigation across web, native and offline readers

tasks.scope: Define a development Project profile with stable work-item IDs, goals, dependencies, authority, decisions, evidence and handoffs. GitHub remains execution authority; plan.json remains requirement authority.
tasks.tests: Fixture includes issue closure without requirement completion, blocked work, reopen, unavailable evidence and disputed acceptance. Unknown fields retained; cycles bounded; no issue text grants agent authority. Scope/status terms documented.
tasks.title: Specify Project work items using Foundation delivery as the reference case

tasks.scope: Build a one-way exporter for explicitly selected public Foundation issues and permitted evidence. Record source IDs, revision/time, scope and snapshot limitations; preserve portable task relationships.
tasks.tests: Deterministic unchanged snapshot; updates preserve stable IDs; pagination, missing/deleted references and rate-limit interruption are explicit. Offline second reader recovers next action. Private repositories/comments/attachments are excluded unless separately authorized; no remote code executes.
tasks.title: Export GitHub execution records into a versioned Project Prim

tasks.scope: Have a fresh executor read only exported work and produce a reviewable next-action proposal. Specify optional writeback with expected revisions, allowlisted fields and explicit authority; keep writes disabled until tested.
tasks.tests: Stale revisions, revoked grants, unauthorized field changes, replay and conflicting ownership all refuse safely; idempotent retry does not duplicate issues. No exporter or record may self-grant authority. Demonstrate continuation without original chat.
tasks.title: Prove agent handoff and specify conflict-safe Project writeback

tasks.estimate: 6–16 active hours plus owner disposition if needed
tasks.scope: Inspect project-scoped dependency provenance privately; establish reuse authority before publication. Diagnose actual versus intended host behavior and reconcile existing PRs in isolated branches.
tasks.tests: Reproducible build against verified dependency; test expectations justified from contracts; positive/negative host and pairing tests pass; no stub, lost source or broad reset. Escalate only a concrete unresolved ownership question.
tasks.title: Resolve Desktop source lineage and the 27 legacy host assertions

tasks.scope: Explain purpose, local storage, saving and export; walk create/find/edit/download/offline reopen without GitHub or terminal vocabulary. Preserve existing API/MCP identities.
tasks.tests: Actual desktop and phone-size browser journeys pass; keyboard, overflow, unsaved changes, stale tabs and failed downloads are tested. Accessibility automation reported separately from assistive-technology acceptance.
tasks.title: Audit and repair the self-service Hub entry journey

tasks.estimate: 8–20 active hours after trust contract review
tasks.scope: Prepare explicit publisher trust and namespace-transfer proposal before implementation; enforce publication, alias/transfer and revocation authority while preserving pinned offline versions.
tasks.tests: Unauthorized overwrite, conflicting ID/version bytes, withdrawal, stale refresh, unavailable publisher and replay fail safely. Hashes never imply publisher identity; reviewed contract precedes remote activation.
tasks.title: Implement and test authenticated publisher and namespace lifecycle

tasks.scope: Map preview cookie/account boundary and current production clients; prepare real Apple/login/container tests using authorized accounts before any cutover.
tasks.tests: Real login, expiry, logout, wrong-tenant and cross-container access checks pass; synthetic versus actual evidence distinct. Deployment uses exact artifact and observed rollback; blocked account action reported concretely.
tasks.title: Prepare and execute real Browsers login and isolation acceptance

tasks.scope: Inventory supported versions, operating costs, recovery objectives and ownership gaps; prepare build/restore/deploy/rollback instructions and a sanitized failure exercise.
tasks.tests: Clean environment reproduces artifact; new-destination restore and preview rollback work. Actual operator accepts role; a different maintainer completes rehearsal. No fabricated owner or spending authorization.
tasks.title: Prepare the operator and replacement-maintainer recovery rehearsal

tasks.scope: Prepare participant tasks, consent boundaries, sanitized demonstrations and evidence index for creation, correction, transfer and recovery; do not ask founder to debug installation.
tasks.tests: Record unassisted task success, intervention, confusion and lost work; private telemetry off. Independent technical/security and user findings tracked to fixes. Recompute readiness only after every critical gate and scoped review is evidenced.
tasks.title: Prepare independent usability and release evidence package

tasks.estimate: 1–3 active hours once Projects capability is available
tasks.scope: Create one Project view over existing issues, with Ready, In progress, Blocked, In review and Done; do not copy tasks into a new authority. Current connector exposes issue operations but no Projects operation.
tasks.tests: Board contains existing issue IDs; statuses reconcile with issue execution state; no duplicate tasks. Filters show package, priority and blocker. Read back membership/fields. Until then issue #9 and the repository index are the usable queue.
tasks.title: Add a GitHub Projects board when project-scoped access is available
